subject: Request: One-off extension and trial credit uplift for NimbleHealth
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan@redwood.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-12T09:18:00-07:00
Subject: Request: One-off extension and trial credit uplift for NimbleHealth

Logan —

Quick ask: NimbleHealth (Kyle Ramirez, CTO) is pushing to extend their sandbox/Pilot beyond our standard PLG limits and needs a one-off credit uplift to prove the connector across 3 clients. Details: they want a 45-day extension on top of the original 30d (so ~75d total) and an additional $12,000 in free credits to cover a higher token burn for the medical data ingestion tests.

Why this matters: Nimble is a high-velocity midmarket opportunity (fast PoC, multiple hospitals already contracted internally). If the PoC shows data fidelity at scale we have a clear path to a Dedicated deal next quarter (HS-qual). Sales forecast has a 60% chance of conversion within 90 days if we remove the runway constraint.

Attachments: nimble-sow.pdf (PoC milestones), mvp-cost-estimate.xlsx (usage forecast).

Ask: Can we get exec approval to uplift credits + extend the PoC tenor as a one-off? I want to capture the authorization in writing so I can share a limited addendum with procurement. Proposed guardrails below — happy to tighten per Finance/Legal.

Proposed guardrails (Marissa suggestion):
- One-time $12,000 credit, sandbox-only.
- Max consumption cap set in account (tokens equivalent ~180k).
- Extension capped at 60 days beyond the original 30d (i.e., total 90d) — willing to drop to 45 if exec prefers.
- Addendum signed via DocuSign before credits applied.
- No change to standard pricing beyond PoC.

Timelines: procurement expects decision by EOD Tuesday to keep their pilot schedule.

Thanks —
Marissa Cole
Account Exec, Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com

---
Attachments: nimble-sow.pdf, mvp-cost-estimate.xlsx

From: Logan Wright <logan@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-12T11:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: One-off extension and trial credit uplift for NimbleHealth

Marissa —

Thanks for the summary. Can you add two quick items for the approval packet?
1) Success criteria / milestone list (what specifically will demonstrate PoC success at the end of the uplift).
2) A hard cap in token units (not just $) and confirmation that telemetry is enabled so we can reconcile burn against milestones.

Also please confirm whether the customer will sign an addendum that includes the credit cap and sandbox-only language. If Legal needs to review the addendum, flag that now so we don't miss the procurement deadline.

If you can push those in the next couple hours I can escalate to Jonas and we can get a decision.

- Logan
Head of Sales Operations, Redwood Inference
logan@redwood.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>
Cc: Logan Wright <logan@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-12T14:47:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: One-off extension and trial credit uplift for NimbleHealth

Jonas / Aditya —

Following up with the packet per Logan's note. Quick bullets:
- Deal / context: NimbleHealth (provider of outpatient imaging workflows). They need to run a larger-scale ingestion & anonymization test across 3 pilot hospitals (higher token usage due to imaging metadata parsing and long-context transcripts).
- Proposed concession: one-time $12,000 sandbox credit; extension request of +45 days beyond current 30d (i.e., total 75d). If you prefer, we can reduce to +30d.
- Success criteria (they agreed):
  * Ingest 3 hospital data sets (test files provided) and produce structured metadata for 95% of records
  * Average latency < 350ms per request at 90th percentile
  * Integration test with their EMR connector and two-way sync validated by their dev team
- Consumption cap: token cap set at 180,000 tokens, enforceable by account policy; credits stop at cap.
- Controls: sandbox-only environment, telemetry and token-tracking enabled, weekly usage report to Redwood CS and Procurement, addendum to capture caps and termination rights.
- Upside: 10% off first committed invoice if they convert to Dedicated within 90 days of PoC close (we'll include as a conversion incentive).

Attachments: nimble-sow.pdf, mvp-cost-estimate.xlsx, nimble-addendum-draft.docx (draft addendum for Legal).

Asking for: Exec sign-off to proceed with 1) $12k sandbox credit, 2) +45d extension (or +30d if you prefer tighter), subject to Legal and Finance sign-off on the addendum.

Customer urgency: Procurement needs paperwork to begin this week to meet their internal pilot dates.

Thanks —
Marissa

From: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Logan Wright <logan@redwood.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-13T09:16:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: One-off extension and trial credit uplift for NimbleHealth

Marissa / Team —

Appreciate the detail. Approving a one-time concession with conditions below. Please treat this as authorized, conditional on Legal/Finance completing the addendum review and Procurement returning a signed PO.

Approved concession (conditional):
- $12,000 one-time sandbox credit (applied only after DocuSign addendum executed).
- Extension approved at +30 days beyond the original 30d (total 60d). I prefer the tighter runway.
- Token cap enforced at 180,000 tokens; credits stop when cap is reached.
- Credit and extension only for sandbox environment; no production access without Dedicated purchase.

Conditions:
- Legal to review nimble-addendum-draft.docx within 48 hours and return comments.
- Finance (Aditya) to confirm accounting treatment for the credit; do not provision until Finance signs off.
- Procurement must provide a PO stating the pilot start/end dates and acknowledgement of the sandbox-only clause.
- Sales to include weekly usage reports to CS and Finance while credits are available.

Aditya — please confirm Finance OK. Once Legal/Finance sign off, Marissa proceed to execute DocuSign and share link with Procurement.

Jonas Weber
Chief Revenue Officer, Redwood Inference
jonas@redwood.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Kyle Ramirez <kyle@nimblehealth.com>, Procurement <procurement@nimblehealth.com>
Cc: Logan Wright <logan@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-14T16:02:00-07:00
Subject: RE: Request: One-off extension and trial credit uplift for NimbleHealth

Kyle / Procurement —

Great to speak earlier. Quick update and the approved terms so you have it in writing. Jonas Weber (CRO) has conditionally approved a one-time sandbox credit and a shortened extension. Key terms below:

Approved (conditional) terms:
- One-time $12,000 sandbox credit to be applied only after the addendum is executed via DocuSign.
- Extension: +30 days beyond the original 30-day pilot (total pilot window = 60 days).
- Token cap: 180,000 tokens. Credits will stop at the token cap; usage above cap will bill at standard PLG rates.
- Sandbox-only: sandbox environment only; no production usage under this concession.
- Weekly usage reports to be shared with Nimble Procurement and Redwood CS.

Next steps for NimbleHealth:
1) Please review and sign the addendum here: https://docusign.net/sign/ABCD1234 (Marissa will send the finalized DocuSign after Legal/Finance clears).
2) Submit PO referencing DEAL-9341 with pilot dates and "sandbox-only" clause.
3) Once signed and PO received, we will provision the credits and enable the token cap.

Notes: Legal and Finance are reviewing the addendum now; Marissa will update you within 48 hours with any edits. If you would like to shorten the start window to align with your dev schedule, call me and we'll prioritize.

Thanks — looking forward to getting this turned on and seeing quick results.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Exec, Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com
